cloud_model.description: Primary cloud Gemini model (web), for example gemini-3.5-flash-lite. Empty = the model the app was built with. Open browsers pick up a change within an hour.

cloud_fallbacks.description: Comma list of cloud models tried in order when the primary is out of quota or busy. Empty = the app's built-in list.

allow_cloud.description: Kill switch: false stops all cloud calls. Can only tighten a parent's choice, never loosen it.

referee_cloud_answers.description: On-device referee checks every cloud answer before the child sees it.

max_device_chars.description: Longest question sent to the on-device model in one call.
